insights.text: No Good / Needs Attention / High Risk status is shown because PRISM's thermal-status model has not yet been validated with expert-labelled data from the farm.

Latest readings: air temperature 30.1 °C, humidity 81 %, warmest thermal-camera reading 35.7 °C. The thermal camera measures apparent surface temperature (about ±2.5 °C accuracy), which is not the same as the pigs' body (core) temperature.

Look at the pigs: fast breathing (more than about 50 breaths per minute at rest), panting or open-mouth breathing, lying apart from each other, wallowing in dung or a fouled pen, and low activity are signs that pigs are struggling with heat.
Keep clean drinking water available and the pen well ventilated during hot periods.
